params.body:
## Why

The website module runs inside an iframe that the dealer's site stretches to the document height (`documentHeight` message, R S2-5.18). The iframe viewport therefore is the whole document, and the "Stel een vraag" and Car-Pass dialogs used a `position: fixed` overlay: centred in ~2000 px of page instead of in what the visitor sees. Measured on preview on 2026-09-18: iframe 1963 px, dialog at 626 px, visitor viewport 800 px scrolled to the button. The dialog opened above or below the screen, or not visibly at all.

## What

- `detail.blade.php` passes the click event: `website.getModal(url, event)` for the question form, `website.show(document.getElementById('w-carpass'), event)` for the Car-Pass explanation (was a bare `classList.add('open')`).
- `website.js`: `anchorFrom(event)` records the document height of the click before the fetch; `show(overlay, event)` adds `w-modal-overlay--embedded` when `window.self !== window.top`, sizes the overlay to the document and places the dialog: top just above the click (24 px), never above 16 px or past the end of the document; when it does not fit below the click its bottom sits on the click. Without an event (older blade, programmatic call) the dialog is centred in the document. Outside an iframe nothing changes: fixed and centred.
- `website-detail.css`: `.w-modal-overlay--embedded` is absolute, document-sized, with the dialog's auto margin removed (website.js sets the top).
- Success state of the question form (same preview screenshot, 12:51): confirmation in regular weight instead of 600; the send button in sentence case ("Versturen"; `global.send` is `VERSTUREN`/`SEND`/`ENVOYER`/`SENDEN` in every language file, the old theme's habit, not a leak from the dealer's theme since no dealer CSS reaches the iframe); the disabled send button is hidden after a successful send (`[hidden]` now beats the `inline-flex` of the button rule), leaving only "Sluiten".
- Form, fetch and lead flow untouched.

## Rules and tests

- R S2-6.4 gains a sentence on the dialog position and the success state, with `code:` sources; `php bin/rules-sources` prints "Geen problemen".
- Finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-18-iframe-modal-buiten-beeld.md` (deze week, Shane, opgelost).
- `WebsiteModalPositionTest` (4 tests) pins the wiring in the HandlerWiringTest style: the blade passes `event` to both modals, website.js handles the second argument and the embedded class, the CSS makes the embedded overlay absolute, and the success-state rules.
- Verified with headless Playwright against a local host page that resizes the iframe on `documentHeight`, at 1280x800 and 390x844, before and after, plus the direct URL (overlay stays `fixed`).

Test run: AlpineExpressionTest, HandlerWiringTest, CompiledViewsTest, StylesheetSyntaxTest, RulesCoverageTest, RulesIdentityTest, BuildContractTest, WebsiteModalPositionTest, WebsiteIframeHeightTest, WebsiteThemeTest, WebsiteWarrantyCalculatorTest, WebsiteEmbedScriptTest: 40 tests, 934 assertions, OK. `npm run build` passes.
params.title: Website module: open the dialogs at the height of the click inside the iframe
